scope: source-only mathematical hypothesis screening; no new target-policy selection
source_policy: unchanged OpenVLA-OFT production checkpoint and action head

families.update_geometry: raw and L1-normalized per-task production total gradients; mean-sign, PCGrad-sign, PCGrad-vector, exact final-box max-min; preserve fractional coordinates
families.interaction: same-state native and synthesis PP/AP/PA/AA; direct action-AA, unconstrained interaction, solo-penalized interaction, solo-constrained final-box LP
families.uncertainty: source fit-cache action-space ellipse; absolute/relative robust scores and generalized-eigen control, offline screen before 7B execution

math_components: standard LP, robust optimization, inclusion-exclusion, and eigentheory are explicitly acknowledged as prior mathematics
interpretation: conditional bounds require actual assumptions; native quantization/BF16 need not satisfy smooth Hessian assumptions
shared_assets: controller prepatches source XML once; workers never unpatch; restore original state only after all workers exit
gpu_policy: 4090 GPU4 forbidden; use GPUs0 and2 for source workers subject to free-memory check, GPU1 for action-head-only analysis; leave other GPUs untouched
limitations: four fresh source states per split cannot establish closed-loop success, cross-policy transfer, or reviewer novelty score
screen: require improvement over strongest relevant baseline, not only weak mean-sign; report all starts, steps, and states
